description: Interesados en la creación de videojuegos para adaptarlos a las salas de clases.
summary: Our project is about designing a game of a space mission, we called it "My Space Journey" it counts with 2 space missions, one inspired in Apollo 13 and the second one is about a Rover and his exploration of Mars. The game is designed using ren'py and its code language is python. The importance of our game is an educational one, we focus on giving the game an educational identity, we look to make Chilean students learn with this.
details:
The main idea of our project is to make a new way of learning science and physics with a videogame, to make students take interest in this type of class.

It works like a visual novel coded in Ren'py (Phyton). The biggest benefit the project can offer is make learning more ludical to students from the Enseñanza media on Chile, and make them see that are opportunities to study astronomy in Chile
